The exemplar and the Board's replica cell ignore the text veto
body:
## Summary
commitExtractRun promotes a replica's best-scoring filed round as an exemplar, and the Board shows the same pick, whatever has_text says.

## Description
lib/foundry/extract/store.ts:423 sorts filed rounds by score; lib/decision/v1/sources/extract.ts:87 bestRound is the same rule written again ("commitExtractRun's own pick"). c1dda99e made helpers.ts textVetoed keep text rounds out of the recipe in force; exemplars are what later generation conditions on (generated-output-grading / unconditional-fail-criteria). Fixing store alone would split the Board's cell from the commit, so both sites move together onto one helper - the Board file is board-decision-adapters' context.

## Flow
- replica rounds [0.8 clean, 0.95 has_text] -> commit promotes the 0.95 frame; the Board shows it
- fix: helpers.ts exemplarRound(rounds) = best filed, unvetoed round; store.ts and decision v1 extract read it; transfers with readback.has_text skipped

## Expected impact
A text-bearing render stops entering the catalogue as evidence. Could break: a replica whose every round drew text promotes no replica exemplar.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - an exemplar never carries a vetoed render
Before: 2 of 2 pick sites ignore has_text (read of both)
After: predicted 0 of 2; Board cell equal to the commit pick
Method: simulation - out-of-scope seam (lib/decision)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: decision-v1-extract.test.ts case: rounds 0.8 clean vs 0.95 text -> cell file is the 0.8 one; a commit case asserting the exemplar file

title: settleReason ends the loop target-met on a round that drew text
body:
## Summary
packages/producers/src/extract/units.ts settleReason returns target-met when the last round scores at target, even when its critique has_text.

## Description
units.ts:104 reads last.score only. After c1dda99e such a round cannot become the recipe, so the loop stops having adopted nothing from its best attempt; a vetoed round should not count as arrival. RoundView needs critique.has_text in its view.

## Flow
- round 1 0.846 clean, round 2 1.0 text, rounds 3 -> settles target-met at 2, never tries round 3

## Expected impact
A text render no longer ends the critique loop early. Could break: a run spends one more round where it used to stop.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the loop's arrival rule honours the veto
Before: 1 of 1 walked case settles on a vetoed round
After: predicted continues to round 3
Method: simulation - packages/producers is outside this round's paths
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: packages/producers/test/extract.test.ts settleReason case: critique.has_text true at score >= target -> null (loop open)

title: A refused critique settles its replica as no-usable-fix
body:
## Summary
A round whose image drew but whose critique was refused (vendor or spend window) settles the replica as no-usable-fix, an abandonment, and a retry never re-asks the critic.

## Description
performReplica.ts:87-93 keeps the round with file, error and critique null; units.ts:105 usableFix(null) -> no-usable-fix; pruneFailures keeps the round (breaker.ts:58). types.ts:123-131 defines no-usable-fix as a critic with nothing to change - here it was never asked, and after a budget stop a raised ceiling buys no critique.

## Flow
- critique throws over-budget -> stopFor; retry -> next() sees the replica settled no-usable-fix and moves on
- fix candidates: settleReason null for an errored critique so the next round regenerates, or a critique-only unit

## Expected impact
Exemplars stop carrying a false abandonment; a budget retry finishes the loop. Could break: unit counts and stepName if a unit kind is added.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the settle reason matches what happened
Before: 1 of 1 walked path misclassified
After: predicted 0 of 1
Method: simulation - rule lives in packages/producers (out of scope); design choice between two fixes
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: style-extract case: critique refused once on round 1, prune + retry -> settleReason is not no-usable-fix and round 2 is generated
drain_note: pinned on purpose; needs a new SettleReason; the obvious fix spends an image per refusal

title: A transfer whose readback failed is never read back again
body:
## Summary
A transfer that drew but whose readback failed keeps score null forever: hasFailures says nothing failed and next() treats the scene as done.

## Description
performTransfer.ts:58-64 records t.error with t.file set; drive.ts hasFailures and breaker.ts pruneFailures count only transfers with no file; units.ts next() checks scene presence. A refused source read is retried; a refused transfer readback is not.

## Flow
- readback refused on transfer 1 -> run done, t.score null -> --retry: no failed units

## Expected impact
A retry recovers a missing transfer score. Could break: each retry spends a recognise call.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every failed vendor call is retryable
Before: 0 of 1 readback-failed transfers retryable
After: predicted 1 of 1
Method: simulation - needs a unit-shape change in packages/producers
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: style-extract case: transfer readback refused once, prune, run -> t.score non-null; hasFailures true before the retry
drain_note: reverses the stated keep-the-paid-pixels design; a product call
